key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, status and resources are refreshed.

key.name: use-pkexec
key.description: Run start/stop through pkexec (graphical polkit password prompt) instead of passwordless sudo.

key.name: twingate-binary
key.description: Path to the twingate CLI executable.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Send a native notification when the connection state actually changes (connected/disconnected/error). Note: GNOME's own Do Not Disturb setting already suppresses notification banners system-wide regardless of this setting.

key.name: ping-enabled
key.description: Periodically ping each authorized resource's address to show a reachability dot. Disable to skip pinging entirely.

key.name: ping-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, resource reachability is re-checked via ping. Independent of the status poll interval.
